  "notes": "The document provides separation (termination) rates by years of service only, not by attained age. The rates are constant across all ages for a given service year. The target grid requires rates by age x service. Since the source rates are independent of age, the broadcast mechanism is used to repeat the service-based rates across all target age rows. The source tables provide rates for specific service years (0-4, 5-9, etc.) and specific single years (0, 1, 2, 3, 4). The target columns (1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 11, 12, 30, 40) are mapped from the source service rows using overlap_weighted logic where bins differ (e.g., source '0-4' covers target 1, 2, 3, 4; source '5-9' covers 6, 8; source '10-14' covers 10, 11, 12; source '30+' covers 30, 40). The source tables are transcribed as printed with service as rows. The 'Males' and 'Females' columns are averaged (series_op: 'mean') to produce a single rate per service year, as no headcount table is provided to weight them by population. The values are in percent and will be converted to decimal by the code."
